name: Mouse down
description: Hardware-style mouse switch press.

name: Mouse up
description: Short switch release for pointer up.

name: Soft contact
description: Restrained click for a secondary pointer action.

name: Hard contact
description: More prominent contact for a committed click.

name: Dry click
description: Brief click with little tail for repeated pointer actions.

name: Light click
description: Light contact for small hit targets.

name: Weighted click
description: A more pronounced click for a primary action.

name: Hover contact
description: Short rollover for pointer entry.

name: Hover crossing
description: Rollover for moving between adjacent controls.

name: Hover focus
description: A distinct rollover for focus entering a control.

name: Hover menu
description: A separate rollover for menu item transitions.

name: Wheel step
description: One short scroll detent.

name: Light wheel
description: Alternate short detent for a light scroll control.

name: Weighted wheel
description: A fuller detent for a rotary control.

name: Wheel increment
description: A distinct increment for stepped values.

name: Wheel boundary
description: Scroll cue for a section boundary.

name: Trackpad tap
description: Compact click for a trackpad-style interaction.

name: Pointer select
description: A separate click for selecting a target.

name: Switch click
description: Short switch cue for a binary control.

name: Switch throw
description: Alternate switch cue with a distinct action.

name: Switch return
description: A return cue for a two-state switch.

name: Switch latch
description: A positive cue for a latched control.

name: Switch detent
description: One switch contact for a stepped selector.

name: Toggle engage
description: Engage a switch or preference.

name: Toggle disengage
description: Disengage a switch or preference.

name: Alternate toggle
description: Distinct toggle cue for a secondary control.

name: Toggle cycle
description: A different cue for cycling a control.

name: Control choose
description: Audible selection in a compact control.

name: Segment change
description: Change segments in a grouped control.

name: Menu choose
description: Commit a menu choice.

name: Option advance
description: Change to the next option.

name: Option confirm
description: Commit an explicit option selection.

name: Soft drop
description: Release an item onto a target.

name: Drop into slot
description: Set an item into a defined slot.

name: Drop snap
description: Release an item into a snapping target.

name: Weighted drop
description: A more pronounced release for a large item.

name: Control open
description: Open an auxiliary UI surface.

name: Control close
description: Close an auxiliary UI surface.

name: Window expand
description: Cue a window growing into its workspace.

name: Window minimize
description: Cue a window leaving its workspace.

name: Control back
description: Return to the previous surface.

name: Menu open
description: Cue an opened menu or compact flyout.

name: Confirm choice
description: Confirm a committed choice.

name: Confirm action
description: Confirm completion of an explicit action.

name: Control question
description: A cue for an unresolved choice.

name: Invalid control
description: Reject an unavailable control action.

name: Slider step
description: One increment on a stepped slider.

name: Slider notch
description: Alternate notch for a discrete control.

name: Slider limit
description: Cue a discrete slider endpoint.

name: Step confirm
description: Confirm a step in a short interaction.
